verdict.rationale: Ente Auth is an end-to-end encrypted 2FA app with a sync service, not an agent, so shipping an official MCP server is plausible and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents an MCP server. The llms.txt file, the export CLI and the enteauth:// deep links are adjacent features, not an MCP server an agent could connect to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
